title: Quantile-aware observability: per-endpoint / model / region telemetry and dashboards
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Add first-class quantile telemetry and exploration surfaces that let SREs and engineers slice 95th and 99th percentile latency by: API route (endpoint), model artifact/version, and region/availability zone. This ticket covers: telemetry emission schema, aggregation pipeline changes, minimal query surface for the Console, a Grafana/Console dashboard template (heatmap + waterfall + time-series percentiles), and instrumentation in the synthetic load harness to produce tokens/sec and percentile signals for regression detection.

Rationale: current summaries (p50/p90) hide tail behavior. We need automated attribution and lightweight dashboards to find whether a p99 spike is caused by a specific model variant, route, region, or a traffic pattern (e.g., long-context prompts). The implementation must be storage-efficient (rollups, TTL), support real-time alerting, and be queryable by the Console for ad-hoc investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry: per-request metadata includes route, model_version, region, seq_len and is emitted to ingest with quantile labels
Aggregation: backend produces per-minute p50/p75/p90/p95/p99 and sample-count per (route, model_version, region) keys and stores 90 days of rollups
Dashboards: Console/Grafana template with dropdown filters (route, model_version, region) and tiles: time-series percentiles, heatmap of percentile over time, and waterfall attribution view
Load harness: synthetic driver produces stable tokens/sec and can inject tail cases (long prompts, KV-cache-miss) and results in detected regressions via change-point alerts
Regression detection: system raises an alert and creates a ticket when a quantile deviates beyond configured baseline with statistical significance (configurable window and sensitivity)
Docs: Console help doc + runbook for incident triage referencing dashboard links and playbook steps
tasks: Design telemetry schema and backward-compatible flags (Aisha)
Implement ingest-side tag enrichment and sampling rules (Mateo)
Add aggregator job for quantile rollups and TTL retention (Infra team)
Create Console dashboard template and Grafana export (DesignOps)
Extend synthetic load harness to produce tail scenarios and tokens/sec metrics (Performance team)
Implement simple change-point detector and alerting rule (SRE)
Write runbook and update docs + examples (Developer Docs)
QA: run regression harness against canary and compare baseline vs new metrics (QA)
comments: 2026-02-25 Aisha Kapoor: Initial write-up and goal-setting. Proposed to reuse existing percentile emitter but add model_version and route as primary keys. Putting estimate at 5 pts given cross-team work.

2026-02-27 Mateo Rios: Spike complete. Found that current aggregator only stores p90 and p50 which requires redesign to efficiently compute p95/p99 without full raw retention. Prototype using TDigest on the ingest path looks promising; needs memory/CPU benching.

2026-03-02 Infra (Liu Chen): TDigest prototype passes functional tests. Concern: high-cardinality model_version X route X region keys could blow up cardinality. Proposed mitigation: only materialize top N high-traffic model versions per route and fallback to model-family rollups for low-volume keys.

2026-03-04 DesignOps (Priya Shah): Dashboard mockups ready: time-series percentiles with stacked region overlay, per-route violin plot, and a heatmap for p95 over the past 7d. Shared in Figma: https://design.redwood.com/file/oq2-quantile-dashboards

2026-03-06 Mateo Rios: Implemented ingest tags and TDigest aggregator in staging. End-to-end test with synthetic harness shows p95/p99 visible in Console. Need to add alerting rules and tune sampling thresholds.

2026-03-09 SRE (Connor Blake): Draft alert rules added to staging: alert when p95 > baseline*1.5 for 10m and sample-count > 100. We should evolve to statistical change-point detection instead of fixed multiplier; adding follow-up ticket for detector tuning.

2026-03-10 Aisha Kapoor: Updated acceptance criteria to require 90 days of rollup retention and a minimal runbook. Blocking: decision on cardinality policy and whether to make per-key materialization configurable per tenant. Scheduling architecture review on 2026-03-12.
2026-03-10 Mateo Rios: Linking PRs and dashboards. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2387, Grafana export: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/quantiles/endpoint-quantiles
notes: Trade-offs discussed: full raw retention would be easiest for arbitrary slicing but is cost-prohibitive. Using TDigest + top-N materialization balances cost and utility.
Performance: aggregator adds ~8% CPU at peak in staging; will gate via sampling and top-N policy during rollout.
Privacy: no user PII is added. Model_version tag must be redacted if customer requests; add tenant opt-out flag.
Follow-ups: separate ticket to add automated attribution that breaks down percentile contributions by prompt length and KV-cache hit/miss.
Owner: telemetry schema = Aisha, aggregator = Infra, dashboard = DesignOps, harness = Performance
